about: The cases of the platform check (integration_test/platform_check_test.dart in the Flutter app, a script of its own in the Python app). Everything here is invented: the logs are the synthetic ones of test/fixtures/python_reference/dives/, the clip is ffmpeg's test pattern. The report each implementation writes is described in REPORT_FORMAT.md beside this file.

dives.about: Each log is parsed by the parser registry (the format detected from file_name and the bytes). For each dive: its summary and, at each of sample_seconds after its start_time, the waypoint Dive.get_waypoint_at gives, reduced to the fields below (tanks: pressure_bar per tank key).

rules.about: The rules engine (assets/hud_rules.json; hud_rules.json in the Python repo) on the dummy dive (utils/dummy_telemetry.py build_dummy_dive(variant, ccr)). At each of times_s, the waypoint waypoint_at(dive, t) with the dive's waypoints as history. Then, from waypoint_at(dive, forced_from_s), each of forced_states through forced_dive(), and resolve_state on its waypoint and history.

renders.about: As tests/test_template_golden.py of the Python app (render_half): the template's normal.json loaded and its variant markers stripped (load_page), drawn by draw_hud on a black 1920x1080 RGB frame for the dummy dive build_dummy_dive('single_tank', ccr). A state 'ccr@<s>' is waypoint_at(dive, s) with the dive's waypoints as history; any other state is forced_dive(waypoint_at(dive, forced_from_s), state). The frame is cropped to the bounding box of the pixels that are not black (any channel above 0) and halved by area averaging to (w // 2, h // 2), at least 1x1. The id is the golden image's name without '.png'.

color.about: The colour engine (ffmpeg/color.py ColorCorrectionEngine) on computed frames, with the bundled profiles (assets/color.yaml; color.yaml in the Python repo). A frame is picture(width, height, seed, base, gain, torch) of tool/python_reference/color_fixture.py: for each pixel (x, y) and channel c (0 red, 1 green, 2 blue), noise = ((x * 73856093) ^ (y * 19349663) ^ ((c + 1) * 83492791) ^ (seed * 2654435761)) mod 41 - 20 (mod as Python's %, never negative); value = base[c] + (x * gain[c][0]) // width + (y * gain[c][1]) // height + noise, plus 70 - 10 * c inside the disc (x - width // 3)^2 + (y - height // 2)^2 < (min(width, height) // 6)^2 when torch is 1; clipped to 0..255. Integer maths throughout. The filter is get_filter_matrix(frame); the corrected frame is apply_filter(frame, filter) (with the profile's sharpening).

engine.about: The platform's real media engine. Correctness on clip.mp4 beside this file (2 s, 1280x720, tagged BT.709 as a camera's clip is, so that every engine reads its colours the same way; every implementation uses these bytes; the desktop also makes it again with ffmpeg_args and reports whether the bytes are the same: engine/ffmpeg_generate). engine/source_clip reads the clip itself the way the outputs are read (probe and frames), the baseline the colour runs are compared against. The runs: 'color' is the Color page's colour correction alone (desktop ColorRun.processVideoLut, Python ColorCorrectionEngine.process_video_lut), 'color_overlay' colour correction with an overlay (OverlayRun.processVideo, Python process_video with overlay_instances), 'overlay' the Overlay Generator's render of the overlay alone for the clip's length, once per output format (TelemetryRun.render, Python cli_main.py's --render-video-log loop on FrameSink), desktop only. The dive is the dummy dive; the clip starts at match_date on the dive computer's clock. Performance: the runs of perf.runs on perf.clip, timed (engine/perf/<run id>); see perf.about.

perf.about: The timed runs, on perf_clip.mp4 beside this file (the same file on every platform: a desktop reads it from the repo, a phone gets it through the system file picker, its SHA-256 checked). Each run of 'runs' is done 'repeats' times; only the run call itself is timed. The overlay runs are desktop only. Not regenerated: ffmpeg_args records how the file was made.

known_differences.why: A value the log does not carry is null in the port where the Python parsers store 0. (keys: the waypoint fields, a tank's pressure under tanks)
The port's one shared deco pass sets surf_gf for every format.
The port keeps the Shearwater export's gradient factors on the dive.
